FBI Offers $50,000 Reward for Information on Gangster Goldy Brar

The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has announced a reward of $50,000 for information leading to the capture of gangster Goldy Brar. Brar is described as a 'most wanted' criminal and is reportedly based in the United States, leading a group in North America. The FBI is seeking information to apprehend him.
